items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: Now when me and Sammy Morgan was playing together, Sammy Morgan was playing with the Magnolia band.

ctx.x: Bay Bay. That was his band, the Superior band, orchestra. He played in that band. Oh, it's pitching in the paper. He used to play with all the old gasp and them, and I'm going to raise them, that's what I tell you. I used to help him carry the drums and play with them. Was that Imperial or Superior? Imperial. Imperial.

Imperial. Yeah, the Imperial and Superior. They see bands, them days they didn't go by a man's name. They didn't go by a man's name, they didn't go by a man's name, they didn't go by a man's name like you go by a certain person, they didn't go that way, they go taking the name. Now when me and Sammy Morgan was playing together, Sammy Morgan was playing with the Magnolia band. Yeah. You understand, the Magnolia band, Sammy Morgan was playing trumpet.
